# Waving Edge Venture

> An independent software development studio in Malaysia, working with SMEs and startups
> internationally. We build custom web apps, internal business systems, SaaS products,
> integrations and automation for businesses that need more than an off-the-shelf solution.
> We work directly with clients from requirements and architecture through development,
> deployment and long-term support — no agency layers.

- Website: https://www.wavingedge.com/
- Contact: hello@wavingedge.com
- Based in Malaysia; works with clients internationally
- Engagement model: independent studio, direct collaboration with the people building your software

## Services

- **Build a new product**: Turn an idea into a practical MVP or production-ready web app without
  over-engineering the first version. SaaS platforms, MVPs, customer portals, web apps.
- **Digitise business operations**: Replace spreadsheets, manual processes and disconnected tools
  with software designed around actual workflows. Internal management systems, booking systems,
  rental systems, inventory systems, operations dashboards.
- **Integrations and automation**: Connect existing systems and remove repetitive manual work.
  API integrations, payment gateways, SMS/messaging, email systems, Shopify integrations,
  third-party services.
- **Improve existing software**: Modernise, extend, maintain or repair software a business already
  relies on. Feature development, UI modernisation, performance improvements, legacy system
  improvements, ongoing maintenance.

## Solutions

E-commerce, SaaS products, business systems, internal tools, client portals, reporting dashboards,
automation, integrations.

## Process

1. **Understand** — Discuss the business problem, workflow and requirements.
2. **Scope** — Define the recommended solution, project scope and estimated effort.
3. **Build** — Design and develop the app iteratively with regular feedback.
4. **Launch** — Deploy, test and prepare the system for real users.
5. **Support** — Continue improving, maintaining and supporting the app.

## Technologies

Laravel, PHP, React, Next.js, TypeScript, MySQL, Shopify, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, cloud
infrastructure. Tools are chosen per project for stability, performance and long-term
maintainability.

## Contact

Email hello@wavingedge.com with what you are trying to build, improve or automate. Typical
response within one business day.
